comparison.objective: Cross two trailer safety chains and hook each end link to the opposite pin, versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual chain routing, hooking, and release under gravity, not fine rotary adjustment or diagnostic cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Chains cross under the tongue, attach to opposite pins, avoid the table, and are released; candidate requires safe repeated carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Hooking and routing flexible chains do not duplicate adjustable-damper commissioning.
